verdict.rationale: Twenty documents custom fields with 20+ field types, plus views that filter with AND/OR logic, sort by multiple fields, group records and save as custom views. A community user corroborates that setup is easy and customization is promising. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that saved views can be shared with teammates, confirmation that a non-admin ops user can add fields without admin or developer involvement, and hands-on corroboration of view building.
